svg.title: vLLM on Amazon EKS architecture
svg.desc: An operator workstation runs scripts that create an EKS cluster in us-west-2. The VPC spans three availability zones with public and private subnets. Two managed nodes in private subnets each run one vLLM pod behind a ClusterIP Service. Nodes pull the vLLM image from Docker Hub and model weights from Hugging Face through a NAT gateway.
svg.text: Stores the Deployment, Service and ConfigMaps
CloudFormation stacks for cluster, node group, IAM roles
EC2: instance type offered in each availability zone
Service Quotas: G-instance vCPU limit (8 needed for GPU)
namespace vllm, one pod per node (anti-affinity)

g.text: float16 on GPU, bfloat16 on CPU
float16 on GPU, bfloat16 on CPU

svg.text: Script that creates or uses it
bfloat16, eager mode, 1 GiB KV cache
GPU type not offered in every zone,
not enough G-instance quota, or the
GPU node group fails to create
quota and capacity checks, CloudFormation via eksctl
Run from the vllm-eks/ directory. Each step checks its own result and stops on failure.
